notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.samsclub.com/robots.txt) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow and no blanket Disallow: / - only /search, /cart, /checkout, /account, /orders, /login etc are blocked, none of which were used. Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome120) succeeded for the homepage and for individual category (/browse/, /b/, /cp/) pages, which embed a Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ JSON blob containing props.pageProps.initialData.searchResult with fields aggregatedCount, count, catInfo{catId,name} and breadCrumb - this is the authoritative source used for every row. Two specific endpoints returned a PerimeterX/Akamai 'Let us know you're not a robot' interstitial instead of real content even via curl_cffi: /sitemap.xml and /all-departments (the client-rendered mega-menu page); Playwright headless Chromium hitting /all-departments hit the same bot-check (tier b blocked on that one page). Since individual category-page fetches worked fine on tier (a), I did not escalate to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome - not needed. TREE: because the mega-menu and sitemap were unavailable, the category tree was assembled by using web search (site:samsclub.com) to discover real category slugs/catIds under Bed & Bath, Home Decor>Rugs, Outdoor & Patio, Storage & Organization and Kitchen & Dining, then verifying each candidate URL by direct fetch and reading the page's own canonical catInfo.name and breadCrumb (which sometimes differs from the URL slug or the search-result title - e.g. slug 'comforters/1435' actually resolves to catInfo.name 'Duvet Covers & Inserts'; slug 'window-treatments/1365' resolves to 'Blinds & Window Treatments'). Only categories with a directly-verified live page are recorded; this is a targeted-verification tree, not an exhaustive crawl, so some minor subcategories Sam's Club may carry were likely not discovered. QTY: qty = searchResult.aggregatedCount from each page's own embedded JSON (the site's stated total across pagination), evidence cites the exact field path. EXCLUDED: 'Blinds & Window Treatments' (catId 1365) was excluded from Textile - itemStacks sample showed it is a genuinely mixed bucket (curtains plus faux-wood blinds and cellular shades, i.e. non-textile hardware), with no separable curtains-only URL/count on the site, so recording its qty under Textile would misrepresent a majority-non-textile listing; excluding avoids fabricating a split. 'Bath Accessories' (catId 10270125) was excluded from Textile - itemStacks sample was overwhelmingly non-textile fixtures/electronics (towel warmers, scales, showerheads, vanity mirrors, bidets, ventilation fans) with only a couple of incidental fabric shower-curtain/bath-mat products, so primary product type is not textile. 'Storage & Organization' root (catId 1424, aggregatedCount 353) and 'Mattress Toppers & Pads' (catId 1437) and 'Rugs' (catId 1367) were treated as grouping rows only (qty/link withheld) because verified child subcategories exist, per the parent-category-URL rule. Restaurant/commercial/B2B listings (Restaurant Table Linens, Restaurant Towels, Restaurant & Commercial Kitchen Storage, Commercial Food Storage Containers) and brand-rollup pages (Member's Mark Storage & Organization) were excluded as out of scope for this home-textile/home-storage extraction. Apparel, groceries, electronics, furniture (sofas/tables/wardrobes), decorative-only accessories (vases, planters, decor), and bathroom fixtures were excluded per the category rule boundaries. Sam's Club is a membership warehouse club; no membership/paywall gating was hit for browsing these category listing pages (no login was required to view products or counts), though full store/zip-code-specific pricing/availability elements were not needed for this extraction.
